items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false; candidate_exclusion_reason established_therapy_only; bevacizumab = established_therapy_experiment
items.reason: Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) used in a new setting, 'concomitant radioprotectant bevacizumab' to allow 'Dose escalation to 75 Gy'. Rule 6 makes it established_therapy_experiment. The other reading (supportive radioprotection) is not a candidate either, so S6 fails in both cases.

note: any_molecular_selection true because entry requires 'IDH wild-type, MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma' (MGMT counts; IDH-wildtype alone would not). This is moot for the analysis, since the trial is excluded at S6. The trial goes on the separate established-therapy list. D31-A8 confirms: MGMT with a required value (unmethylated) is eligibility.
